title: Urashima Taro
summary: Taro rescues a turtle, follows it underwater to a wondrous palace, receiving a secret box.

sentences.text: Urashima Taro was a young man who lived near the blue sea in a small village.
Every day, he took his small boat out onto the water to catch fish for his family.
One afternoon, while he was fishing near the coast, he saw a group of children making trouble for a small animal.
Taro felt very sorry for the poor creature, so he walked over and asked the kids to leave it alone.
The kind man picked up the animal and put it safely back into the blue sea.
The creature swam away happily, but it turned around once and looked back at Taro with a smart expression.
The next day, while Taro was sitting in his boat, the same animal appeared near the surface of the water.
The creature spoke to him and invited him to visit the wonderful sea building which stood deep under the waves.
Taro was very surprised, but he climbed onto the shell of the large creature and began his journey.
They went down through the cool water until they reached a grand castle made of white stone and gold.
A beautiful woman came out to the door to welcome him, because she was actually the animal that he had saved.
She thanked him for his help and offered him fine food and wonderful music inside the wondrous place.
The man stayed in the sea building for what seemed like a few days, and he enjoyed every single moment.
However, after a short period, Taro began to feel sad for his mother and his small village.
He told the woman that he must return home, though he was quite sad to leave her and the lovely area.
The woman gave him a heavy box, but she told him that he must never open it under any condition.
Taro rode back on the animal until he reached the familiar beach where he had started his adventure.
When he stepped onto the land, he looked around with a confused face, because everything had changed completely.
The houses were different, the people were strangers, and nobody remembered his family or his name.
He soon realized that hundreds of years had passed on earth while he was away in the sea building.
Feeling very sad and full of sorrow, the old man forgot the warning of the woman and opened the hidden box.
A white cloud of smoke came out of the container and rose quickly up toward the open sky.
Taro felt his body grow old and weak in a single second as the power took effect.
He fell softly onto the sand, finally returning to the dust of history where his true time waited.
Many years before these events, the village had grown around the bay where the blue water met the land.
People lived peaceful lives and worked hard every single week to build their futures.
Taro was just a simple person who loved his family and cared for the sea around his home.
Whenever he went out in his boat, he always watched the waves and thought about the mysteries of the world.
The ocean was deep and full of life, providing food and support for everyone in the community.
No one could have guessed that a simple act of kindness would change his life forever.
When he saved the small creature, he started a chain of events that led him into a different dimension of reality.
The grand castle under the waves was more beautiful than anything he had ever imagined before.
Music played softly through the halls, and the food tasted better than the meals in his mother house.
He spent hours walking through the gardens and talking with the woman who ruled the underwater palace.
She told him stories about the ocean and how the various creatures lived together in peace and harmony.
Taro listened with great interest and felt that he had found a second home beneath the blue waves.
Yet, the thought of his aging mother always remained in the back of his mind like a persistent shadow.
He knew that she would worry about him if he stayed away for too much longer without sending any word.
The woman understood his feelings and gave him the box as a final gift before his departure.
She made him promise that he would never open it, because the container held a secret power.
Taro agreed to her terms and thanked her for the wonderful time that he had experienced in the castle.
The journey back to the surface was quiet and peaceful, taking him through the same cool water.
When his feet touched the sand of the familiar beach, he felt a strange breeze blowing from the land.
The world had moved on without him, leaving behind only memories and old stories told by strangers.
Houses were rebuilt, trees grew tall, and the faces of the villagers were entirely unfamiliar to his eyes.
He walked through the streets looking for someone who might remember his father or his mother.
Every person he approached looked at him with surprise and told him that they had never heard his name.
Realizing that time had played a cruel trick on him, he sat down on the ground and began to cry.
The heavy box rested in his hands, feeling warmer than it had when the woman first placed it there.
Overwhelmed by sadness and despair, he broke his promise and lifted the lid of the mysterious container.
White smoke poured out into the air, carrying away the last remaining years of his youth in an instant.
His skin grew wrinkled, his hair turned white, and his bones became weak as the years caught up with him.
He lay down upon the sand and closed his eyes, drifting into a deep sleep that would last forever.
The sea continued to crash against the shore, washing away the footprints of the man who had traveled through time.

sentences.text: Many years before these profound events unfolded, a quiet fishing village had grown organically around the azure bay where the deep blue water met the jagged land.
Here, humble people lived peaceful lives and worked hard every single week to build sustainable futures for their growing families.
Taro was merely a simple young man who loved his elderly mother dearly and cared deeply for the vast ocean surrounding his modest home.
Whenever he pushed his wooden boat out into the open water, he always watched the rolling waves and pondered the ancient mysteries of the world.
The ocean was unimaginably deep and full of vibrant life, providing daily sustenance and quiet comfort for everyone in the coastal community.
Every single day without fail, he took his small boat out onto the water to catch fish for his dependent family.
One lazy afternoon, while he was fishing near the rocky coast, he noticed a group of cruel children making trouble for a small, defenseless creature.
Taro felt an immediate pang of sorrow for the poor creature, so he walked over and firmly asked the kids to leave it alone.
The kind man carefully picked up the frightened animal and placed it safely back into the cool blue sea where it belonged.
The creature swam away happily into the depths, but before disappearing completely, it turned around once and looked back at Taro with a surprisingly smart expression.
No one in the village could have guessed that a simple act of spontaneous kindness would alter the entire trajectory of his life forever.
When he saved that small sea creature, he unknowingly started a chain of extraordinary events that led him straight into a different dimension of reality.
The next day, while Taro was sitting alone in his boat, the exact same animal appeared near the sparkling surface of the water.
The grateful creature spoke directly to him in a gentle voice and invited him to visit the wonderful sea building standing deep under the mysterious waves.
Taro was thoroughly surprised by this impossible invitation, but without a moment of hesitation, he climbed onto the shell of the large creature and began his improbable journey.
They descended slowly through the cool, shimmering water until they finally reached a grand castle constructed entirely of white stone and gleaming gold.
A remarkably beautiful woman emerged from the majestic doorway to warmly welcome him, revealing herself to be none other than the grateful animal he had rescued the day before.
She thanked him sincerely for his timely help and offered him fine food and wonderful music inside the wondrous palace.
The grand castle under the waves was vastly more beautiful than anything he had ever imagined seeing during his ordinary life on land.
Soft music played continuously through the vaulted halls, and the exotic food tasted much better than the simple meals in his mother house.
He spent countless hours walking through the breathtaking gardens and talking intimately with the mysterious woman who ruled the underwater palace.
She told him fascinating stories about the deep ocean and how the various marine creatures lived together in perfect peace and complete harmony.
Taro listened with great interest to every word she spoke and felt deep down that he had somehow found a second home beneath the blue waves.
The man stayed in the wondrous sea building for what felt like only a few days, and he thoroughly enjoyed every single magical moment.
However, after this brief period had passed, Taro began to feel a sudden wave of sadness for his aging mother and his small village.
The persistent thought of his mother always remained in the back of his mind like a quiet shadow, reminding him of his familial duties.
He knew quite well that she would worry endlessly about him if he stayed away for too much longer without sending any reassuring word.
He politely told the woman that he must return home immediately, though he was quite sad to leave her and the lovely underwater domain behind.
The understanding woman listened to his plea and gave him a heavy, ornate box as a final parting gift before his departure.
However, she made him promise solemnly that he must never open the mysterious container under any condition whatsoever.
Taro agreed completely to her strict terms and thanked her profusely for the wonderful time that he had experienced within her magnificent castle.
The journey back to the surface was remarkably quiet and peaceful, taking him smoothly through the same cool water that had brought him down.
When his tired feet finally touched the familiar sand of the beach where he had started, he felt a strange, cold breeze blowing harshly from the land.
He rode back steadily on the faithful animal until he reached the exact shore, stepping out into a world that felt entirely alien to his senses.
When he stepped onto the dry land, he looked around with a deeply confused face, because everything had changed completely while he was away.
The familiar houses were entirely different, the people walking past were complete strangers, and nobody remembered his family or his proud name.
He wandered aimlessly through the unfamiliar streets looking for someone who might recognize his father or remember his mother.
Every single person he approached looked at him with sudden surprise and told him firmly that they had never heard his name before.
He soon realized with mounting horror that hundreds of years had passed on earth while he was away living inside the magical sea building.
The world had moved on relentlessly without him, leaving behind only forgotten memories and old, faded stories told by passing strangers.
Houses had been completely rebuilt, tall trees had grown and died, and the faces of the villagers were entirely unfamiliar to his tired eyes.
Realizing fully that time had played a cruel and irreversible trick on him, he sat down heavily on the cold ground and began to cry.
Feeling very sad and full of unbearable sorrow, the weary old man completely forgot the solemn warning of the woman and opened the hidden box.
The heavy box rested in his trembling hands, feeling noticeably warmer than it had when the woman first placed it into his care.
A thick white cloud of smoke billowed out of the opened container and rose quickly up toward the open, indifferent sky.
Taro felt his physical body grow old, frail, and weak in a single fraction of a second as the hidden power of the box took immediate effect.
His skin grew deeply wrinkled, his hair turned stark white, and his bones became painfully weak as the stolen centuries caught up with him at last.
Overwhelmed entirely by sudden despair, he fell softly onto the warm sand, finally returning to the dust of history where his true time had always waited.
He lay down peacefully upon the shore and closed his heavy eyes, drifting slowly into a deep, unending sleep that would last forever.
The vast ocean continued to crash rhythmically against the shore, washing away the final footprints of the man who had traveled far beyond the borders of mortal time.
